summary.text: Aron Wieder is a Democratic member of the New York State Assembly who has represented District 97 since January 2025 and is running for re-election in 2026.
He previously served on the Rockland County Legislature and the East Ramapo School Board.

paragraphs.text: Aron Wieder was born and raised in Brooklyn, graduated from Machzikei Hadas Yeshiva and continued his studies at a rabbinical college in Israel.
He has lived in Rockland County for more than 30 years and lives in Spring Valley with his wife and two children.
Wieder was elected to the East Ramapo School Board in 2008 and served as its vice president and later its president during a three-year term.
From 2009 to 2011 he was confidential assistant to the mayor of Spring Valley.

He was elected to the Rockland County Legislature in 2011, representing Spring Valley, and was re-elected for four terms; he served as majority leader and chaired the Public Safety Committee and later the Budget and Finance Committee.
Wieder took office in the Assembly on January 1, 2025, and serves on the Banks, Children and Families, Election Law, Insurance, and Local Governments committees.
His official biography says he is committed to fiscal responsibility, public safety and quality of life for District 97 families.
